prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for an original Russian match-3 roguelike.
Primary request: create exactly ONE 1024 x 1536 portrait sprite sheet, actual transparent alpha background, strict 3 columns by 4 rows of equally sized cells, 12 separate full-body poses. No visible cell boundaries.
Style: authentic very LOW-resolution minimal pixel sprites with a Deltarune battle mood, but entirely original characters, never existing protagonists. Each pose must look like a tiny sprite drawn at roughly 48 x 64 logical pixels and enlarged using crisp nearest-neighbor squares. Use huge square pixel clusters and only 5–8 flat solid colors per character. Intentionally simple shapes, not detailed pixel painting. NO gradients, glow, dithering, detailed textures, 3D shading, antialiasing, soft edges or illustrations pretending to be pixel art.
Row 1, left to right: HERO idle, HERO windup, HERO strike.
Row 2: HERO guard, HERO hurt, HERO death lying on the ground.
Row 3: RIVAL idle, RIVAL windup, RIVAL strike.
Row 4: RIVAL guard, RIVAL hurt, RIVAL death lying on the ground.
HERO is the same original teal-faced young traveler in every pose: cropped white hair, purple tunic, long cyan cloak, amber sword firmly held in the right hand, small round shield in the other hand. Hero always faces RIGHT. Exactly two arms and two legs.
RIVAL is the same original gangly mint-white checkerboard jester in every pose: crescent helmet, crooked magenta halberd firmly held in hands. Rival always faces LEFT. Exactly two arms and two legs.
Atlas geometry: all 12 poses stay fully inside their own cells including every weapon tip, helmet, cloak and limb. Generous transparent margins and gutters, no touching between poses. Standing poses have the same body scale and feet baseline at 90% of their cell height. Center the BODY in each cell, not the combined body-and-weapon silhouette. Death poses stay near that same ground baseline. Windup prepares a swing, strike clearly extends the held weapon toward the opponent without an effect arc, guard clearly braces, hurt visibly recoils. Compact full-body compositions allow every weapon to remain safely inside the cell.
Avoid: labels, letters, text, UI, background, checkerboard transparency preview, glows, shadows, extra objects, extra limbs, separated or floating weapons, effect trails. The background must have genuine transparent alpha, never painted transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 wide battle arena background for an original Russian match-3 roguelike.
Primary request: create one 1536 x 864 landscape, all-original LOW-resolution pixel art environment with a strong minimal Deltarune battle mood, no existing game assets. Mostly PURE BLACK negative space. A very sparse deep violet grid floor occupies the lower half. Two magenta-red pixel willow silhouettes stand at the far left edge and far right edge. A thin cyan BROKEN ARCH appears in the distant center. Leave the central battle area and foreground empty. A plain low purple platform runs across the bottom edge.
Style: genuinely tiny low-resolution pixel scene enlarged in hard nearest-neighbor square blocks, minimal black-violet-cyan palette with muted magenta-red trees. Large crude square clusters, flat solid colors, austere retro battle staging. No smooth curves or detailed pixel painting. No gradients, glow, dithering, antialiasing, 3D, detailed textures, ornamental busy textures or busy scenery.
Constraints: no characters, no objects in the fighting area, no text, labels, logos, UI, borders or watermark. Keep the scene sparse and mostly black; trees at the extreme sides, distant thin broken arch in the center, plain bottom platform. One complete background only.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG icon atlas for an original Russian match-3 roguelike.
Primary request: one 1536 x 1152 image with genuine transparent alpha, strict 4 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells. Exactly 12 separate icons in this exact row-major order.
Top row, left to right: amber sword; cyan shield; purple lightning bolt; yellow four-point focus star.
Middle row: green venom flask; white bomb with orange fuse; red heart; yellow coin.
Bottom row: red potion; mint amulet; white crown; white four-point reward star.
Style: authentic very LOW-resolution minimal pixel sprites with Deltarune battle mood but original icons. Each icon should use the minimum pixel vocabulary of a roughly 16 x 16 logical-pixel sprite enlarged using crisp nearest-neighbor square blocks. Only 2–4 flat solid colors per icon, extremely simple and highly readable silhouettes. Large square pixel clusters. No gradients, shading gradients, glow, shadow, dithering, antialiasing, 3D, detailed textures or detailed pixel painting.
Composition: center each icon in its own square cell. The visible art occupies roughly 60% of each cell, giving large genuine transparent margins and gutters. No overlap or touching; every shape fully inside its cell. No visible grid.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no checkerboard preview, no text, labels, background, UI, extra icons, sparkles or decoration. One atlas only.
